name: Choi Luciel
source:
Occupation: Hacker
Likes: Racing cars, math, potato chips

Works as a secret agent. Computer whiz. Unpredictable. Claims to be a devoted Catholic. Often speaks incomprehensible words.

"Be careful because I am dangerous. You wouldn't want to be too involved with me..."

[Edited from [url=http://msg.cheritz.com/characters/707]official page[/url]]
